stories.title: Cloud-hosted loop runner — GHA cron running loop.sh run --once
stories.description: Run loop.sh run --once on a scheduled GHA cron so the loop survives machine-off. Has a known blocker: the worktree reaper needs local disk, so this requires a self-hosted runner or a board-read-only dispatch variant.
